messages:
zoe: Quick post-launch decision needed: do we run two sprints pure-bugs or allow a 'micro-enhancements' fast-path? Proposing micro-enhancers only if <3h dev + tests + flag.

krish: +1 to micro-enhancers rule. Add customer-impact override: if a paying customer asks and it's non-blocking, fast-path ok with CS sign-off.

marta: Ops constraints: we can support 1 hotfix window per day during the sprint. Canaries required for any fast-path merge.

zoe: Draft policy: sprint theme = "stabilize + quick wins" for 2 sprints. Allocation: 80% bugs / 20% enhancers. Fast-path criteria = <=3h + unit tests + feature flag + owner + CS ok for customer asks.

krish: Acceptance metrics to close sprint green: no customer-visible regressions, error rate down 50% vs baseline, p99 latency within 20% of baseline.

marta: I'll schedule the daily hotfix window and add a canary checklist. release-bot, reserve 2026-03-27T15:00Z canary slot.

release-bot: canary reserved: slot-2123456789-1 at 2026-03-27T15:00:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/postlaunch-canary.

zoe: Owners: krish -> infra fixes, marta -> rollout/ops, zoe -> PM/comms. GH label: postlaunch-microwins. Jira swimlanes created.

krish: Will open PRs for the top 6 P0/P1 bugs now and tag owners.

marta: Added rollback flag + muted noisy alerts channel for the canary.

zoe: Plan locked unless objections by EOD. Weekly sync Thu 09:00 PT. Quick follow-up: who will update status page after canary?

krish: I'll push the status page update once canary is green.

marta: :thumbsup:

zoe: Thanks all.
